archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-flush
archetypes.rationale: Changed ship and CI paths depend on warning-triggered run-log flush ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the guideline warning flush paths in ship.py, ci_monitor.py, and ci_agentic_fix.py. Check that warnings appended after the main Step 7a flush are committed before any existing PR or CI-fix push. Pay special attention to skipped flush handling, pending rebase retries, and paths where callbacks fail or return false. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
